copiedDriver.section: type Player through summarize; only playSeries adds sequential async game-boundary yields

methodology.candidate: Production StrategyEngine with capitalAllowance true and headsUpFaceBidWeight 0.3
methodology.control: Frozen capital-enabled v1, paired against the same archetype by seed and measured seat
methodology.opponentCaveat: Only the published acquisition floors over frozen-v1 search/words; not verified replicas or strength claims about named live bots.
methodology.seatRotation: Alternating two seats across series, fixed seat within each three-game series
methodology.setup: Copied locked driver: actual creation and registration; fixture only equal-prior post-Swiss Final status; actual finals start/auction/word/end/crown reducers thereafter
methodology.inputs: Own authenticated rack and public match/balance/auction/settled-payment history only
methodology.driver: Same word-first transaction driver for all policies; cooperative event-loop yield after each game; simulated clock/RNG/action logic unchanged; no post-final-award actions
methodology.victory: Actual server crown from three aggregate scores, then equal prior totals and lower bot id
methodology.cacheLifetime: Fresh independent policies per paired series, retained across its three games; shared immutable production/frozen indexes
methodology.analysisUnit: Thirty paired seeds per archetype. Overall differences equally average the two archetypes WITHIN each seed, n=30, not 180 independent games.
methodology.timing: Measured in-process wall time >100ms; excludes worker/network and the production 150ms response gate
methodology.limitations: This tests two fixed acquisition-price archetypes. It does not test novel word policies, adaptive rivals, Swiss/top-cut qualification or transport. Later RNG tile streams may diverge. Deadline-bounded search can vary with wall time.
methodology.promotion: Report only; no automatic gate, parameter selection or production authorization
